audience.text: C++ developers building desktop or server applications that require parsing, authoring, or converting MSG, CFB, and EML email formats without external library dependencies.

capabilities.text: Read, build, and write generic Compound File Binary containers directly through cfb_reader, cfb_storage/cfb_stream, and cfb_writer.
capabilities.title: Low-level CFB access

capabilities.text: Create, edit, save, and reload Outlook-style messages through mapi_message with support for subject, plain-text and HTML bodies, and sender identity.
capabilities.title: High-level message authoring

capabilities.text: Add To/Cc/Bcc recipients with add_recipient, attach files from byte buffers or streams with add_attachment, and embed full messages as attachments.
capabilities.title: Recipients and attachments

capabilities.text: Save an in-memory mapi_message to .eml and load .eml back into a mapi_message using the library's own MIME engine without external dependencies.
capabilities.title: MSG/EML interoperability

limitations.text: No SMTP, IMAP, POP3, or other network mail-protocol support — this library reads and writes MSG, CFB, and EML containers and messages already on disk, in memory, or in a stream; it is not a mail client or transport library.
No PST (Outlook Personal Folders) archive support — only single MSG-format messages and generic CFB containers are supported, not multi-message PST stores.
Only a curated subset of MAPI properties has a dedicated named accessor on mapi_message; every other property must be read and written through the generic get_property_value()/set_property() pair.

problems_solved.text: Enables deterministic, byte-level reading and writing of Outlook MSG files and CFB containers without third-party dependencies.
Provides both high-level message authoring via mapi_message and low-level structural access via msg_reader/msg_document/cfb_reader for advanced use cases.
Supports interoperability between MSG and EML formats through a built-in MIME engine without external dependencies.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for C++ is a C++17 library for reading and writing binary email containers and messages, including Compound File Binary (CFB) containers, Outlook MSG documents, and RFC 5322 / MIME EML files, with deterministic output and no third-party dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of MAPI properties supported by the high-level mapi_message API is not fully enumerated in the facts.
Whether the library supports reading or writing HTML bodies in MSG format is implied but not explicitly confirmed by example or symbol data.
The behavior of strict-validation mode surfaced through validation_issues() is described in the README but not directly verified by fact IDs.

workflows.name: Build from source
workflows.text: Clone the repository and configure with CMake 3.26 or later using the provided install command.

workflows.name: Read MSG files
workflows.text: Open an MSG file as a binary stream and use mapi_message::from_stream to extract message properties such as subject.

workflows.name: Create and save messages
workflows.text: Create a new message using mapi_message::create, set properties like sender and recipients, and save to both MSG and EML formats.
